dedupe_keys.name: montpellier irrigated urban canyon microclimate soil and plant observations

description: INRAE and partners publish observations from a constructed street canyon on their Montpellier research site. Six planters with different plant types and irrigation regimes were monitored between 21 July 2023 and 31 July 2024. The repository describes 102 air and radiation variables across the canyon at 1.3 m height, with readings every 30 seconds, plus soil water and temperature every 10 minutes and plant measurements. The public Recherche Data Gouv page lists CSV and tabular files under the Etalab Open Licence 2.0; access is free. Urban microclimate and stormwater modellers can compare irrigation and planting scenarios against measured heat, humidity and soil-water responses. The experiment covers one short, artificial canyon, so its wall dimensions and local Mediterranean climate should not be assumed representative of a whole city. Sensor placement and gaps need checking in the file readmes before calibration. It complements data-leeds-urban-canyons-temperature-humidity from a different urban setting. No data file or PDF was downloaded.
